basic_info.description:
DOLORES PARK SUN FILLED APT - 1st month rent free

Noe Valley 2BR, 1BA Apartment available for rent.

This property is located along the "J" Church Muni Metro line, walk to 24th St. The Castro and the Valencia Corridor, dining and shopping, tech and bus stops. Easy access to Highway 101/280. Walkscore: 97 

The building is located adjacent to Dolores Park. Unfurnished unit is located in a 5-unit building. Open floor living room with large window. Beautiful hardwood flooring. New carpet in bedrooms. Front bedroom has view of downtown and walk-in closet. Back bedroom has southern exposure and is warm and sunny. Kitchen has dishwasher. Entire apt. newly painted. Ideal for work from home. 
Shared roof deck with a fantastic view available for tenant use. 

Off street parking in remote access open air garage included. Coin-op laundry on-site. 

Security Deposit: $2,950
1st Month's Rent: $2,950
Utilities included: Water and Garbage
One-year lease; month to month thereafter.

If interested, email the address to arrange a private showing.

Owner pays for trash and water; tenant pays electric. shared garage under cover with remote opener; only 5 unit building; shared roof top deck; shared washer/dryer in building with easy access; dead end street with close proximity to Dolores Park.
